items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: And his mama was a good friend with Arnold and a lot of his sisters, Gertrude and all their visits our house, you know. They was big friends with us all.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, I know him and Chani.

Yeah, married one of, oh, he's married one of black sisters, you know. Picky did. Well, anyway, now that was all a little bit of children growing up in front of us, you know. And his mama was a good friend with Arnold and a lot of his sisters, Gertrude and all their visits our house, you know. They was big friends with us all. And it's just to say how that family, you know, naturally people passing off, you know. And the younger generation, a lot of them don't do like, see the children of Santiago and different…
Oh, the machine was off when we were talking about Black Benny. What did he play, Black Benny?
